statements.name: date_trunc histogram: a month in UTC

statements.name: date_trunc histogram: a month in Europe/Berlin

statements.name: date_trunc histogram: an hour in Europe/Berlin
statements.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', o.created_at) AS h, count(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.created_at >= timestamptz '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

statements.name: a top N over joins: a *, sorted by a column's number
statements.sql: SELECT c.*, o.id FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 100

statements.name: a top N over joins: every table's columns
statements.sql: SELECT c.*, o.*, i.* FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN order_items i ON o.id = i.order_id ORDER BY (c.created_at) IS NULL ASC, c.created_at DESC LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

statements.name: a LIMIT with no ORDER BY over joins: every table's columns
statements.sql: SELECT c.*, o.*, i.* FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN order_items i ON o.id = i.order_id LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

statements.name: a LIMIT with no ORDER BY over a many-to-many join: every table's columns, no sort
statements.sql: SELECT c.*, o.* FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.tenant_id = o.tenant_id LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

statements.name: a top N over a tool's wrapper of joins: its *, no ORDER BY

statements.name: a top N over a view of joins, sorted by its output
statements.sql: SELECT * FROM customer_orders ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

statements.name: a top N over a WITH query of joins, sorted
statements.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT o.id, o.meta, c.created_at FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id) SELECT * FROM j ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

statements.name: a top N beside a plain derived side, sorted
statements.sql: SELECT c.id, o.meta, o.notes FROM customers c LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, customer_id, meta, notes FROM orders WHERE amount > 1) o ON o.customer_id = c.id ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT 100

statements.name: a LIMIT with no ORDER BY beside a plain derived side on its key: sorted by row number
statements.sql: SELECT o.meta, d.name FROM orders o JOIN (SELECT id, name FROM customers) d ON d.id = o.customer_id LIMIT 100

statements.name: a top N beside a WITH query
statements.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT id, name FROM customers WHERE tenant_id = 'acme') SELECT o.meta, c.name FROM orders o JOIN c ON c.id = o.customer_id ORDER BY o.id DESC LIMIT 100

statements.name: a top N beside an aggregated side, carried
statements.sql: SELECT o.id, o.meta, s.n FROM orders o JOIN (SELECT customer_id, count(*) AS n FROM order_items i JOIN orders x ON x.id = i.order_id GROUP BY customer_id) s ON s.customer_id = o.customer_id ORDER BY o.id DESC LIMIT 100

statements.name: a top N over USING, sorted
statements.sql: SELECT id, o.meta, o.notes, c.name FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING (id) ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 100

statements.name: a top N over a FULL USING, by the merged column
statements.sql: SELECT id, o.meta, c.name FROM orders o FULL JOIN customers c USING (id) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100

statements.name: a top N with a subquery in its list, over a join
statements.sql: SELECT o.id, o.meta, (SELECT count(*) FROM order_items i WHERE i.order_id = o.id) AS items, c.name FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 100

statements.name: a top N with a subquery in its list, one table
statements.sql: SELECT o.id, o.meta, (SELECT count(*) FROM order_items i WHERE i.order_id = o.id) AS items FROM orders o ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 100

statements.name: a LIMIT with no ORDER BY over a NATURAL join, a *
statements.sql: SELECT * FROM orders o NATURAL JOIN order_tags t LIMIT 100

statements.name: a top N over joins by a computed output's name
statements.sql: SELECT o.id, o.meta, c.name, o.amount * 2 AS twice FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id ORDER BY twice DESC, o.id LIMIT 100

statements.name: a top N over joins by a computed key no output shows

statements.name: a GROUP BY the key with wide columns and a LIMIT: grouped on the key, read by row number

statements.name: a DISTINCT with the key and wide columns and a LIMIT: distinct on the key, read by row number
statements.sql: SELECT DISTINCT o.id, o.meta, o.notes, c.name FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id ORDER BY o.id DESC LIMIT 100

statements.name: a tool's wrapper of a many-to-many join, no sort
statements.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT c.id, o.meta FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.tenant_id = o.tenant_id) t LIMIT 100

statements.name: LEFT lateral preview: jsonb_each, LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

statements.name: LEFT lateral preview: json_each, LIMIT 100 OFFSET 200
statements.sql: SELECT q.*, d.key, d.value FROM (SELECT t.id, t.meta FROM orders t) AS q LEFT JOIN json_each(CASE WHEN substring(ltrim(q.meta::text), 1, 1) = '{' THEN q.meta::json ELSE NULL END) d ON TRUE LIMIT 100 OFFSET 200

statements.name: LEFT lateral preview: jsonb_array_elements_text, LIMIT 100

statements.name: LEFT lateral of an unnest of string_to_array, LIMIT 100 OFFSET 1749950
statements.sql: SELECT o.id, p FROM orders o LEFT JOIN unnest(string_to_array(o.notes, ' ')) p ON TRUE LIMIT 100 OFFSET 1749950

statements.name: LEFT lateral of an unnest of string_to_array read by a *, LIMIT 100 OFFSET 1749950
statements.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT t.id, t.notes FROM orders t) o LEFT JOIN unnest(string_to_array(o.notes, ' ')) p ON TRUE LIMIT 100 OFFSET 1749950

statements.name: LEFT lateral of an argument of two columns: unnest, LIMIT 100

statements.name: LEFT lateral sorted by a table column, LIMIT 100

statements.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT q.id, d.key, d.value FROM orders q LEFT JOIN LATERAL json_each(CASE WHEN substring(ltrim(q.meta::text), 1, 1) = '{' THEN q.meta::json END) d ON TRUE) sub

statements.name: LEFT lateral counted, no LIMIT: jsonb_array_elements (not rewritten)

statements.name: LEFT lateral, the nulls idiom on a table column, LIMIT 100
statements.sql: SELECT q.id, d.key FROM orders q LEFT JOIN jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(q.meta) = 'object' THEN q.meta END) d ON TRUE ORDER BY (q.created_at) IS NULL, q.created_at DESC LIMIT 100

statements.name: LEFT lateral sorted by a jsonb column, LIMIT 100 (not rewritten)
statements.sql: SELECT q.id, d.key FROM orders q LEFT JOIN jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(q.meta) = 'object' THEN q.meta END) d ON TRUE ORDER BY q.meta, q.id LIMIT 100

statements.name: LEFT lateral in a CTE another CTE reads, through a derived table, LIMIT 100 outside
statements.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT q.id, d.key FROM orders q LEFT JOIN jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(q.meta) = 'object' THEN q.meta END) d ON TRUE), b AS (SELECT a.key, a.id FROM a) SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM b) s LIMIT 100

statements.name: LEFT lateral in a CTE both arms of a UNION ALL read, LIMIT 100 outside
statements.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT q.id, d.key FROM orders q LEFT JOIN jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(q.meta) = 'object' THEN q.meta END) d ON TRUE) SELECT s.id, s.key FROM s UNION ALL SELECT s.id, s.key FROM s LIMIT 100 OFFSET 999950

statements.name: LEFT lateral under string_agg with no ORDER BY
statements.sql: SELECT q.id, string_agg(d.key, ',') FROM orders q LEFT JOIN jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(q.meta) = 'object' THEN q.meta END) d ON TRUE WHERE q.id < 1000 GROUP BY q.id ORDER BY q.id

statements.name: LEFT lateral sorted by its own key, LIMIT 100 (not rewritten)
statements.sql: SELECT q.id, d.key FROM orders q LEFT JOIN jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(q.meta) = 'object' THEN q.meta END) d ON TRUE ORDER BY d.key, q.id LIMIT 100

statements.name: LEFT lateral with a condition (not rewritten)
statements.sql: SELECT q.id, d.key FROM orders q LEFT JOIN jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(q.meta) = 'object' THEN q.meta END) d ON d.key <> 'n' WHERE q.id < 1000 ORDER BY 1, 2

statements.name: nulls idiom: a timestamp, LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0
statements.sql: SELECT o.id, o.status, o.shipped_at FROM orders o ORDER BY (o.shipped_at) IS NULL ASC, o.shipped_at DESC LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

statements.name: nulls idiom: a text column under a wide select list, LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

statements.name: nulls idiom: IS NOT NULL DESC, a timestamptz

statements.name: a page by one bare key (the idiom's control)

statements.name: not the idiom: the test then another column (not rewritten)

statements.name: count by a column: GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY "count" DESC LIMIT 100

statements.name: count by a wide text column: GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY "count" DESC LIMIT 100
statements.sql: SELECT "notes", count(*) AS "count" FROM "public"."orders" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY "count" DESC LIMIT 100

statements.name: count distinct key: count(DISTINCT id) over the table alone

statements.name: count distinct key: LEFT JOIN a dimension on its key, GROUP BY its name

statements.name: count distinct key: INNER JOIN a dimension on its key, GROUP BY its name

statements.name: count distinct key: FILTER (WHERE …) kept

statements.name: count distinct key: a join on a non-key column (not rewritten)
statements.sql: SELECT t.name, count(DISTINCT o.id) AS n FROM orders o JOIN tenants t ON o.status = t.plan GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY 1

statements.name: count distinct key: a LATERAL jsonb_each beside it (not rewritten)
statements.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT o.id) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(o.meta) = 'object' THEN o.meta END) d ON TRUE

statements.name: count distinct key: a column that is not a key (not rewritten)
statements.sql: SELECT o.tenant_id, count(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS n FROM orders o GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

statements.name: count distinct key: a derived table in FROM (not rewritten)
statements.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT s.id) FROM (SELECT o.id FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'paid') s

statements.name: count distinct key: a column of a composite key (not rewritten)
statements.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT g.order_id) FROM order_tags g

statements.name: count distinct key: a UNIQUE column that is not the key, counted (not rewritten)

statements.name: count distinct key: a join on a UNIQUE column that is not the key (not rewritten)

statements.name: BI shape: cast: ::varchar(n) (truncates)
statements.sql: SELECT o.id, o.notes::varchar(12) AS head, c.name::varchar(3) AS initials FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id ORDER BY o.id LIMIT 20

statements.name: BI shape: function: date(x)
statements.sql: SELECT date(o.created_at) AS day, count(*) FROM orders o GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

statements.name: BI shape: date/time - date/time over columns (interval, integer days)
statements.sql: SELECT o.id, o.created_at - c.created_at AS since_signup, o.created_at::date - c.created_at::date AS days FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id ORDER BY o.id LIMIT 20

statements.name: BI shape: to_char patterns (Month, Day, Mon, IW, IYYY, Q, FM, 9/0 number formats)
statements.sql: SELECT o.id, to_char(o.created_at, 'FMMonth YYYY') AS m, to_char(o.created_at, 'Dy DD Mon') AS d, to_char(o.created_at, 'IYYY-IW') AS w, to_char(o.created_at, 'YYYY-"Q"Q') AS q, to_char(o.amount, 'FM999,999,990.00') AS amt FROM orders o ORDER BY o.id LIMIT 20

statements.name: BI shape: comparison: date vs timestamp / BETWEEN … AND <date>
statements.sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.created_at BETWEEN date '2026-09-01' AND date '2026-09-30') AS inclusive_end, count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.created_at >= date '2026-09-01' AND o.created_at::date <= date '2026-09-30') AS by_date FROM orders o

statements.name: BI shape: generate_series over dates (LATERAL / select list) + LEFT JOIN
statements.sql: SELECT d::date AS day, count(o.id) FROM generate_series(date '2026-09-01', date '2026-09-07', interval '1 day') d LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.created_at::date = d::date GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

statements.name: BI shape: WITH RECURSIVE
statements.sql: WITH RECURSIVE days(day) AS (SELECT date '2026-09-01' UNION ALL SELECT day + 1 FROM days WHERE day < date '2026-09-07') SELECT days.day, count(o.id) FROM days LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.created_at::date = days.day GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

statements.name: BI shape: collation: ORDER BY a text column in a subquery / window ORDER BY text
statements.sql: SELECT s.name, s.rn FROM (SELECT c.name, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY c.name, c.id) AS rn FROM customers c ORDER BY c.name LIMIT 8) s ORDER BY s.rn

statements.name: BI shape: collation: ORDER BY text + LIMIT (outer) / min/max of text
statements.sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c WHERE c.name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.name LIMIT 5
plan: TABLE_SCAN public.customers [top-N filter: name] [zone-map filter: name IS NOT NULL]

statements.name: BI shape: collation: max/min of text, string_agg(DISTINCT)
statements.sql: SELECT o.tenant_id, min(o.status), max(o.status), string_agg(DISTINCT o.status, ',') FROM orders o GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

statements.name: BI shape: percentile_disc / mode()
statements.sql: SELECT o.tenant_id, percentile_disc(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.amount) AS p50, mode() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.status) AS top_status FROM orders o GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

statements.name: BI shape: GROUP BY ROLLUP / GROUPING()
statements.sql: SELECT g, count(*), sum(n) FROM (SELECT o.tenant_id, o.status, count(*) AS n, GROUPING(o.tenant_id, o.status) AS g FROM orders o GROUP BY ROLLUP (o.tenant_id, o.status)) r GROUP BY g ORDER BY g

statements.name: BI shape: CASE in GROUP BY
statements.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN o.amount >= 100 THEN 'big' WHEN o.amount > 0 THEN 'small' ELSE 'zero or less' END AS size, count(*) FROM orders o GROUP BY CASE WHEN o.amount >= 100 THEN 'big' WHEN o.amount > 0 THEN 'small' ELSE 'zero or less' END ORDER BY 1

statements.name: BI shape: window frame: ROWS BETWEEN n PRECEDING / UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
statements.sql: SELECT o.id, sum(o.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY o.tenant_id ORDER BY o.created_at, o.id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last3, sum(o.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY o.tenant_id ORDER BY o.created_at, o.id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running FROM orders o ORDER BY o.id LIMIT 30

statements.name: BI shape: window frame: ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING over an aggregate (Metabase's cumulative sum / count)
statements.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', o.created_at) AS m, sum(sum(o.amount)) OVER (ORDER BY date_trunc('month', o.created_at) ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cum, sum(count(*)) OVER (ORDER BY date_trunc('month', o.created_at) ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS n FROM orders o GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

statements.name: BI shape: ntile / percent_rank / lead with 2 arguments
statements.sql: SELECT o.id, ntile(4) OVER (ORDER BY o.amount, o.id) AS q, percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY o.amount) AS pr, lead(o.amount, 2) OVER (ORDER BY o.id) AS l2 FROM orders o ORDER BY o.id LIMIT 30

statements.name: BI shape: subquery: NOT EXISTS (correlated)
statements.sql: SELECT c.id FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status = 'refunded') ORDER BY c.id
plan: TABLE_SCAN public.orders [zone-map filter: customer_id IS NOT NULL; status = constant]

statements.name: BI shape: subquery: IN (subquery) correlated / scalar in WHERE correlated
statements.sql: SELECT o.id FROM orders o WHERE o.amount > (SELECT avg(o2.amount) FROM orders o2 WHERE o2.tenant_id = o.tenant_id) AND o.customer_id IN (SELECT c.id FROM customers c WHERE c.tenant_id = o.tenant_id) ORDER BY o.id

statements.name: BI shape: subquery: scalar in a JOIN condition (correlated)
statements.sql: SELECT c.id, o.id AS last_order FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.id = (SELECT max(o2.id) FROM orders o2 WHERE o2.customer_id = c.id) ORDER BY c.id
plan: TABLE_SCAN public.orders [zone-map filter: customer_id IS NOT NULL]

statements.name: BI shape: VALUES in FROM with a column list
statements.sql: SELECT v.label, count(o.id) FROM (VALUES ('paid', 'Paid'), ('pending', 'Pending'), ('', 'Empty')) AS v(status, label) LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.status = v.status GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

statements.name: BI shape: IN (list) with 50+ values
plan: TABLE_SCAN public.orders [zone-map filter: id IN constants]

statements.name: BI shape: DISTINCT ON without ORDER BY (nondeterministic in Postgres too)

statements.name: BI shape: regex: Postgres-only escapes (\y, \m)

plan: TABLE_SCAN public.orders [top-N filter: id] [zone-map filter: notes IS NOT NULL]

statements.name: BI shape: array: ARRAY[…] constructor / = ANY(ARRAY[…])
statements.sql: SELECT o.id, ARRAY[o.status, o.tenant_id] AS pair FROM orders o WHERE o.status = ANY(ARRAY['paid', 'PAID']) ORDER BY o.id LIMIT 20

statements.name: BI shape: json ->> / -> on a jsonb column (stored as JSON)
statements.sql: SELECT o.id, o.meta ->> 'status' AS s, o.meta -> 'tags' ->> 0 AS t0, (o.meta -> 'n')::text AS n FROM orders o ORDER BY o.id LIMIT 20

statements.name: BI shape: jsonb #>> array[…] grouped
statements.sql: SELECT o.meta #>> array['status'] AS s, count(*) AS n FROM orders o GROUP BY o.meta #>> array['status'] ORDER BY s

statements.name: BI shape: jsonb @>
statements.sql: SELECT o.id, o.meta @> '{"status": "paid"}' AS paid FROM orders o ORDER BY o.id LIMIT 20

statements.name: BI shape: a UNION's ORDER BY a column number, text under the database's collation
statements.sql: SELECT o.status FROM orders o UNION SELECT c.name FROM customers c ORDER BY 1

statements.name: BI shape: json_each in a LEFT JOIN ON TRUE over a derived table, guarded by a CASE
statements.sql: SELECT q."t.id", q."t.payload", q.domain, q.domain_if_then, d.key AS payload_key, d.value AS payload_value FROM (SELECT "t"."id" AS "t.id", "t"."meta" AS "t.payload", substring((("c"."email")::varchar) from ('@(.*)')) AS domain, CASE WHEN ((substring((("c"."email")::varchar) from ('@(.*)')))::varchar) = ('example.test') THEN ('x') ELSE ('y') END AS domain_if_then FROM "public"."orders" AS "t" LEFT JOIN "public"."customers" AS "c" ON "c"."id" = "t"."customer_id") AS q LEFT JOIN json_each(CASE WHEN substring(ltrim("t.payload"::text), 1, 1) = '{' THEN "t.payload"::json ELSE NULL END) d ON TRUE

statements.name: BI shape: json_each / jsonb_each / their _text in a LEFT JOIN ON TRUE, ordered
statements.sql: SELECT o.id, a.key, a.value::text AS a, b.value::text AS b, c.value AS c, d.value AS d FROM orders o LEFT JOIN json_each(CASE WHEN substring(ltrim(o.meta::text), 1, 1) = '{' THEN o.meta::json END) a ON TRUE LEFT JOIN jsonb_each(o.meta) b ON b.key = a.key LEFT JOIN json_each_text(o.meta::json) c ON c.key = a.key LEFT JOIN jsonb_each_text(o.meta) d ON d.key = a.key WHERE o.id < 40 ORDER BY 1, 2

statements.name: BI shape: jsonb_array_elements_text / jsonb_object_keys in the select list or LATERAL
statements.sql: SELECT o.id, t.tag FROM orders o CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(o.meta -> 'tags') AS t(tag) WHERE o.id < 20 ORDER BY 1, 2

statements.name: BI shape: GROUP BY a primary key, selecting the columns it decides

statements.name: BI shape: GROUP BY a primary key: a decided numeric divided, computed exactly
statements.sql: SELECT o.id, o.amount / 3 AS third, round(o.amount * 1.5, 1) AS r, count(i.id) AS items FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.id ORDER BY o.id LIMIT 20

statements.name: BI shape: Metabase's sum where: sum(CASE … ELSE 0.0 END), the arms the rows took
statements.sql: SELECT o.tenant_id, sum(CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN o.amount ELSE 0.0 END) AS paid, sum(CASE WHEN o.id > 0 THEN o.id ELSE 0.0 END) AS ids, sum(coalesce(CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN o.id END, 0.0)) AS c FROM orders o GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

statements.name: BI shape: Grafana's $__timeGroup: floor(epoch / n) * n
